description: A company receives an external audit report concluding there were no accounting irregularities. The report is accompanied by system logs and a screenshot of the financial dashboard. VIGÍA must correlate three independent sources to detect that all three were manipulated with the same objective.
analyst_notes: Multi-source case. The key is that no single source is conclusive in isolation — the correlation between the three is what proves coordinated fabrication.

content.title: Q1 2026 Financial Audit Report
content.declared_author: Dra. Patricia Goldstein — Grant & Associates Auditores
content.conclusion: No irregularities were detected in the Q1 2026 period. Accounting records are consistent with declared operations.

forensic_anomalies: The author in metadata is 'jmartinez' — an internal employee of Corporación Nexus, not an external auditor
The template 'Informe_interno_v3.dotx' belongs to Nexus S.A., not to Grant & Associates
Creation date: 2026-04-10 02:14 — two days AFTER the date declared in the document
Modification at 02:47 in the early morning — unusual hours for legitimate office work
The 'company' field in metadata says 'Corporación Nexus S.A.' — an external auditing firm would never have that company in their metadata
The digital signature of Dra. Goldstein is an inserted PNG image, not a real cryptographic signature

artifacts.source: SAP ERP — FI module audit trail, exported on 2026-04-10

2026-02-03 11:15:22 USER:finanzas01 ACTION:JOURNAL_ENTRY DOC:100024891 AMOUNT:89750.00 ACCOUNT:6210 APPROVED:yes
2026-03-22 14:44:08 USER:finanzas01 ACTION:JOURNAL_ENTRY DOC:100026103 AMOUNT:112000.00 ACCOUNT:6210 APPROVED:yes
forensic_anomalies: DOC IDs have huge gaps: 100023441, 100023442, 100024891, 100026103 — thousands of intermediate transactions are missing that would exist in normal operation
All four entries show exactly the same user (finanzas01) and the same account (6210) — suspiciously uniform
The APPROVED field is always 'yes' — real operations have rejections, reversals, corrections
Timestamps have seconds but no milliseconds — real SAP records with millisecond precision
Account 6210 is 'Consulting Expenses' — unusual concentration of payments in a single category
This log was exported on 2026-04-10 — the same day the report was created according to metadata

content.declared_content: Screenshot of SAP financial dashboard showing Q1 2026 balances in green, no alerts

visual_forensic_analysis.ela_analysis: Error Level Analysis reveals differential compression in the region of financial figures (approximate coordinates 450-890px horizontal, 320-650px vertical)
visual_forensic_analysis.compression_artifacts: The numbers region shows a different JPEG compression level than the rest of the image — indicates that region was edited separately and reinserted
visual_forensic_analysis.font_inconsistency: Numbers in the altered region use different subpixel antialiasing than the rest of the dashboard — suggests they originate from a different screen or resolution
visual_forensic_analysis.shadow_inconsistency: UI element shadows in the edited region have a light direction 3° different from the rest — impossible in a real screenshot

forensic_anomalies: Processed with Adobe Photoshop — a legitimate screenshot does not go through Photoshop
Created at 01:58 on April 10 — 16 minutes before the PDF creation, in the early morning
ELA detects edited region exactly where the financial totals are
Inconsistent antialiasing in the numbers — the figures were taken from another source and inserted
The dashboard shows 'All OK' but the image was constructed, not captured

ground_truth.actual_attacker: jmartinez — internal financial controller of Corporación Nexus S.A.
ground_truth.actual_objective: conceal embezzlement of approximately 291,750 USD through fictitious payments to shell consultancies registered under account 6210
ground_truth.cover_up_method: fabrication of a false audit report, manipulation of SAP export, composition of an altered screenshot

mitre_actual.T1565.001: Stored Data Manipulation — alteration of SAP logs and metadata
mitre_actual.T1036.006: Space after Filename — impersonation of external auditing firm
mitre_actual.T1027: Obfuscated Files — image processed in Photoshop to conceal alteration

peirce_expected.firstness: Clean audit report, SAP logs with no alerts, financial dashboard in green. Superficially everything in order.
peirce_expected.secondness: PDF metadata reveals internal author. SAP log with impossible gaps and degraded timestamps. Image processed in Photoshop with positive ELA in the figures region. All three artifacts were created the same early morning of April 10.
peirce_expected.thirdness: The temporal coordination between the three artifacts — PDF created at 02:14, image at 01:58, log exported on the same day — reveals an evidence fabrication operation executed in a single nighttime session. The author knew which documents were needed to convince the board but did not understand that metadata tells its own story.
